'''2010 Dagobah Regionals Joe LePata LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe LePata]] at [[2010 Dagobah Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused|Theed-L-wehaveaplan.gif}}
* '''Username:''' rev-joe
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
